_note: Where to read live job titles for contractors (federal entries use USAJOBS). Titles are read once per build, filtered to data/locations.json, and used only to make search find them. Every request first checks the site's robots.txt. Entries in 'skipped' are not read, with the reason.

skipped.saic: jobs.saic.com refuses automated requests (HTTP 403, even for robots.txt).
skipped.rtx-pratt-whitney: careers.rtx.com refuses automated requests (HTTP 403, even for robots.txt).
skipped.amentum: amentumcareers.com has no working location filter, and its search API is disallowed by robots.txt; reading all ~2,800 jobs daily is too heavy.
skipped.sts-systems-defense: The Dayforce job board loads only through scripts, and it may belong to a sibling company (see ROLES-REVIEW.md).
skipped.aafes-hill-exchange: No public job feed found on applymyexchange.com.
